description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LDAPDaoTest' that verifies various functionalities of the 'LDAPDao' class within the OrangeHRM project. The tests cover LDAP user retrieval, employee data fetching, LDAP authentication provider handling, LDAP sync status recording, and associated database interactions. It is specifically designed for testing LDAP-related Data Access Object (DAO) methods in the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: LDAPDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests methods of the LDAPDao class, including user retrieval, employee search, LDAP provider management, and LDAP sync status recording.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee numbers with multiple users.

methods.name: testGetNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval logic for non-local users by username, including cases for non-existing, deleted, disabled, local, and LDAP users.

methods.name: testGetUserByUsername
methods.description: Tests fetching a user by username across various user states and authentication types.

methods.name: testGetEmployee
methods.description: Validates employee data retrieval using different search parameters.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Checks retrieval of LDAP authentication providers by user unique identifier.

methods.name: testGetAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Tests listing all LDAP authentication providers.

methods.name: testSaveLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Verifies saving LDAP sync status and associated data.

methods.name: testGetLastLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the most recent LDAP sync status.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for each test case, loading necessary fixture data.
